item.title: Market & Trade Surveillance in an Era of Policy Shocks
item.description: Trade surveillance has long been viewed as a financial compliance safeguard, a necessary control to detect market abuse, insider trading, and manipulation. Today, that framing is too narrow. A new wave of protectionism, export controls, and tariff shocks has transformed financial market surveillance into a strategic function.
